recommendations: Jose Adan R. “It's rare that you come across a talented individual at such a young age, but Rohan has displayed exceptional skills and knowledge both in software development and entrepreneurship. I had the pleasure to mentor Rohan during the 2017 Make School Summer program where students learned to build their first app in Swift. Rohan already had experience in iOS, but looked for additional help to update his app, Zipshare. When I first looked at the source code, I was amazed at what he had accomplished with both Swift and Firebase. I see that Rohan would be a great iOS engineer in any team.”

projects.title: Joey Labs
projects.description: - Won the best data science hack at the hyphen hacks hackathon- Joey Labs uses cutting-edge optimization algorithms to increase student efficiency- Given a set of assignments and a student's activities, our optimization algorithm finds the most efficient way for them to complete their work and renders it in an intuitive weekly schedule, maximizing free time and sleep.- Built with co-founders Amrit Baveja, and Beck Lorsch

honors_and_awards.title: 1st Place in World Savvy Festival
